author: MeowSamOP DZN
demoNotice: Visual/demo purposes only. GGUF 'loading' is simulated in the browser: files are only read for name and size, never leave the device, and no real model inference runs. Chat replies are canned demo responses.
description: A lightweight, LM Studio-style desktop app for loading your own GGUF models. Visual demo build — no real inference.

install.notes: Total size is under 100 KB — no 2 GB runtime, no installer bloat.
steps: Keep index.html and metadata.json together in one folder.
Option A (instant): double-click index.html — it runs in any modern browser, no server needed.
Option B (desktop app): wrap the folder with a webview shell (Tauri, Electron, or Nativefier). Point the shell at the 'entry' file above and apply the 'window' size settings.
Option C (hosted): drop the folder on Vercel/Netlify/GitHub Pages as a static site.

name: MN Studio
